name: com.hydracept/hydracept
title: Hydracept
description: Directory-safe MCP: quote and run text/domain jobs with OAuth, receipts, BYOK.

environmentVariables.name: HYDRACEPT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hydracept API key from https://hydracept.com/start (or use project secrets after init). Stdio only — the hosted remote uses OAuth, not this key.

environmentVariables.name: HYDRACEPT_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Stdio MCP tools/list for the process lifetime: full (default when unset) or compact (eleven lifecycle tools). Hosted POST /mcp defaults to compact for new API keys; POST /mcp/full always lists all specialists. The registry remote (/mcp/claude) is the directory-safe OAuth surface.
